title: 第7章
content_zh:
高梅丽白了夏真钰一眼说：这还真是结了婚就不一样了，什么话都敢说了啊。不说这个了，还是说说我们周大市长是怎么看上你的，弄不好兴许能来段艳＼遇也不错啊，能被那么极品的男人看上，就是有点什么也是你赚到了，不吃亏！
夏真钰用手指点了下高梅丽的额头：吃还堵不住你的嘴，周瑾宇什么人，启是我这样的小人物可以碰触的？再说也没机会啊，这次还真是意外，估计是我那天的傻样儿把周大市长逗笑了。
高梅丽一提这个就笑个没完：哈哈，还首长好！真钰你国庆阅兵仪式看多了吧？周瑾宇他爸才是首长呢！
听了高梅丽的话，夏真钰好奇的问道：他爸是首长？你怎么知道的？
高梅丽鄙视了夏真钰一眼说：什么叫我怎么知道的？全国人民都知道好不好！你呀，一天除了工作就是看小说，那小说啊还是少看点好，都是假的，全都是少女怀＼春做梦呢。你以为周瑾宇为什么３８岁这么年青就能坐在副市长这个位置上啊，而且还是个实权副市长。
夏真钰看着高梅丽臭显摆的样儿没接话，果然高梅丽也不需要她回答自顾说下去：告诉你，周瑾宇他老子是中＼央的军委的，是老功勋，手下的徒子徒孙从中央到地方遍布全国。他们一家从政从军的都有，周瑾宇几个哥哥在首都是高层，他几个姐姐也都嫁得高干，我听我家那位说了，周瑾宇现在搞的这项目不过是为他高升做垫脚石罢了，人家可是要往上提的，而且是火箭的速度。
夏真钰咋舌啊，原来周瑾宇家世这么显赫，不过周市长的个人魅力也是不可抵挡的啊，再说从那次视察和给他们合同制员工提高待遇来看，也是非常有能力的人哪，所以家世能力人家是都有呀。
两人又扯了些闲话便各回各家了，到了家夏真钰看宋娟正在厨房忙活呢，叹了口气想着哪天得和李巍说下，他妈这样随时随地的出现在家里，自己真的很不习惯，一点隐私都没有，做什么心都是悬着的。
真钰回来啦，我听李巍说了，你工资涨上去了？而且你们领导私下还把你的待遇提到和正式编人员一样了？我和我们那些老姐妹儿说了这个事儿，都夸你是个有福气的，我也和李巍说了在工作上他还得和你多学习，你这点可比李巍强多了，他就永远也围拢不好他们单位的领导。
妈，我来帮您吧。夏真钰换了衣服准备给宋娟打下手。
不用、不用，好容易休息一天哪能用你呢，你回屋休息吧，等李巍回来我叫你。宋娟正为夏真钰能让她在那些老同事、老同学面前露脸高兴哪，所以现在怎么看夏真钰都顺眼。
等李巍回来了，宋娟叫夏真钰起来让她和李巍吃晚饭，自己却说还要回去给李巍他爸做饭就走了，夏真钰和李巍吃过饭看了会儿电视就上床歇下了，两人还是像平常一样聊天，然后李巍聊着聊着就睡了，夏真钰觉得现在她和李巍就靠不停的语言交流才能维系住一份情感，自己一定要配合李巍把这个僵局打破。
这天，夏真钰早上刚到单位就被朱主任叫到楼上去了，朱主任给夏真钰交待了任务：小夏，你准备准备，九点半你陪郭主任去市里汇报工作，怎么样？这段时间对工作内容都了解得差不多了吧，待会儿可不能马虎出错呀。
夏真钰笑着说：主任放心，我每天都有跟进项目的，就是有不懂的地方，中心的技术人员也耐心的给我解答了。
那就好、那就好，去市里汇报你主要把郭主任的材料弄好，领导问话的时候补补漏就行了。哦，对了，今天听汇报的领导是张处长，你去吧，一会到门口等着郭主任的车。
又整理了下材料，夏真钰就到门口等郭主任的车，这些材料都是夏真钰平时就弄好的，为的就是随时随地应付紧急情况。
上了车，郭主任又交待了几句，让她不要紧张，并不用她发言只是关键时候帮自己补补数据漏项什么的。
进了市政府的小型会议室坐好，一会张处长就带人进来了，夏真钰看了一眼张处长，正是视察那天帮众人解围的那个人。
郭主任不亏是科班出身，虽然当了这么些年官有点享乐主义了，不过能力还是在的，而且又吸取了上次的教训，在工作上下了苦功夫的，所以汇报起来有条不紊，工作进度、有哪些意见建议说得是合情合理。
正说着呢，会议室的门就开了，张处长看了进来的人连忙站了起来，其他人也都跟着起来了，夏真钰还没明白怎么回事呢，周瑾宇已经坐在了主位上，并示意郭主任继续，所有人又都安静的坐下了。

夏真钰脸腾的一下红了，刚才所有人一起一坐，就她自己没反应过来一直傻坐着，别提多显眼了，她看见旁边的人瞟了她好几眼呢，自己怎么就这么见不了大场面呢。过了会儿，看已经没人注意她了，这才恢复了脸色认真听郭主任汇报并不时的记录会议谈话。
周瑾宇从进门就看见夏真钰发呆的坐着，直到会议继续进行时她才反映过来脸红不已，他已经认出这女孩儿就是上次问候自己首长好的那位了，这郭怀还真是大胆用人啊！看着她从脸红再到现在强自镇静的样子，他就想笑，眼神就不自觉的有了暖意。
周瑾宇边听汇报，边暗自打量夏真钰，发现其实这女孩还长得挺耐看的，不脸红时皮肤很白，不是苍白而嫩白，让人想摸摸那白瓷般的脸会是什么触感。她记录得非常认真，全神贯注，周瑾宇已经很少能看见这么容易脸红的人了，两次在正式场合出丑的她还真是机关单位里的奇葩！
会议在激烈的讨论中已经临近中午，周瑾宇抬手中断了会议说道：今天大家都很辛苦了，从早上坐到现在，午饭就不在食堂吃了，让秘书先去订下饭店我请大家吃饭，然后再回来讨论。
众人都高兴极了，和周市长同桌进餐多大的荣幸啊，要是能在饭桌上拍照留念就好了。夏真钰收拾了东西就去追郭主任，谁知道他和张处长那几个人还在讨论会议内容，而且都坐进了郭主任的车，那她上哪辆车啊。看没人理自己，就想如果待会车都开走了自己随便到外面找家饭店解决好了，然后等郭主任回来。
这时一辆车开了过来停在她面前，正奇怪是不是随行人员想起来让她搭车了，结果车门被吧。
夏真钰直接想法就是开口拒绝，周瑾宇这么大领导只是开口意思下吧，绝不可能是真的让她上车，但又想对方连车门都能做的。
脑中瞬间闪过无数想法，最后开口说道：谢谢周市长，要不我坐前面吧。说完排而坐呢。
结果第三次出丑立即上演了，夏真钰认为自己这么些年白混了，周瑾宇这么大的领导怎么会没秘书助理之类的呢，这腿都准备迈上去了结果看见副驾驶位置上坐着的人冲她抱歉一笑：不好意思，我是周市长的秘书，还是请您到后面坐吧。
夏真钰再次顶着个大红脸坐进了后坐，抬头的勇气都没了。周瑾宇脸上的笑容更加明显了，看了下还在尴尬的夏真钰说：你是那次操作电脑演示的同志吧？叫什么名字？
巴不得有个话题能缓解自己的状况，夏真钰终于把头抬了起来目不斜视，低声回答：我叫夏真钰。
周瑾宇明白一般人见到自己的紧张，更何况是和自己并排坐在封闭的车里呢，声音更加柔和了：嗯，很特别的名字。你在办事大厅工作多长时间了？
夏真钰是很喜欢周瑾宇能问她一些问题的，这样有问有答才能不尴尬，于是有问必答：我在单位工作快七年了。
周瑾宇听了吃了一惊，七年了？这夏真钰多大年龄，自己一直以为她是刚出校门的大学生呢，再转头仔细看了看，确实夏真钰是经得起近距离考验的，脸上依然白瓷一样细致，翘挺的鼻子，红润的嘴唇，亮晶晶眼睛盯着前的椅背一眨一眨的，年轻得很。
看来自己也有看走眼的时候，笑了下接着说：夏小姐看起来真的是很年轻，家在哪住，上班离单位远吗？
夏真钰说：谢谢周市长夸奖，我家离单位还是比较远的，上班坐公交车要１４站。周市长叫我小夏就好。
作者有话要说：标题、主要内容神马得最伤脑筋了。
还有光光这本书的封面是随意从网上链接顶缸的，所以没有作品名字什么的，大家包涵啊。
本来打算早点睡的，可没想到
☆、初露端倪

听夏真钰要自己称呼她小夏，周瑾宇并未回应，而是又和她谈了些工作上的事情，发现夏真钰对这个项目还是很了解的，而且也有一定的见地，倒是来了兴致。
能把你的手机号给我吗？周瑾宇忽然问了一句。
夏真钰眨了眨眼睛，周瑾宇要自己的手机号？她有些搞不明白了，倒是没多想，因为不可能的嘛。
周瑾宇悦耳的笑声在她耳边响了起来：你别误会，我只是觉得你对这个数字化系统还是很了解的，一定下了不少功夫，所以万一要是有疑问的时候能和你沟通一下。
误会什么啊？自己还没自作多情到那个份儿上，于是大方一笑：不是的，我只是没想到周市长能如此亲民，还有这次我们这些合同制员工待遇能调上去也是托了周市长福，实在是感激得很。
content_en:
Gao Meili rolled her eyes at Xia Zhenyu and said: It's really different after you get married. You dare to say anything. Let’s not talk about this, let’s talk about how our mayor Zhou Da fell in love with you. Maybe it would be good to have a romantic encounter. If you can be taken in by such a top-notch man, even if you have something, you will earn it, and you will not suffer any loss!
Xia Zhenyu tapped Gao Meili's forehead with his finger: "I can't stop your mouth. Who is Zhou Jinyu? Can a little person like me touch him?" Besides, there was no chance. This time it was really an accident. It was probably my silly look that day that made Mayor Zhou laugh.
Gao Meili laughed endlessly when she mentioned this: Haha, thank you to the chief! Zhenyu, have you watched too much of the National Day military parade? Zhou Jinyu’s father is the leader!
After listening to Gao Meili's words, Xia Zhenyu asked curiously: Is his father the chief? How do you know?
Gao Meili looked at Xia Zhenyu with contempt and said: How do I know? People all over the country know, okay! You, besides working all day long, you read novels. It’s better to read less novels. They are all fake. They are all about girls’ dreams of pregnancy and spring. Why do you think Zhou Jinyu can sit in the position of deputy mayor at such a young age of 38, and he is also a powerful deputy mayor.
Xia Zhenyu looked at Gao Meili's ostentatious behavior and didn't answer. As expected, Gao Meili didn't need her to answer and kept talking: Let me tell you, Zhou Jinyu is a member of the Central Military Commission. Their family members are both in politics and the military. Zhou Jinyu’s brothers are high-level officials in the capital, and his sisters are also married to high-ranking officials. I heard from my family that the project Zhou Jinyu is working on is just a stepping stone for his promotion. They have to move up, and at a rocket speed.
Xia Zhenyu was speechless. It turns out that Zhou Jinyu's family background is so prominent, but Mayor Zhou's personal charm is irresistible. Besides, judging from the inspection and the improved salary for their contract employees, he is also a very capable person, so everyone has the ability and family background.
The two chatted some more and then went back to their respective homes. When they got home, Xia Zhenyu saw Song Juan busy in the kitchen. He sighed and thought about how he would have to tell Li Wei someday. He was really not used to his mother appearing at home anytime and anywhere. He had no privacy at all and was always worried about everything he did.
Zhenyu is back. I heard from Li Wei that your salary has been increased? And your leader privately mentioned that your treatment is the same as that of regular staff? I told our old sisters about this, and they all praised you as a lucky man. I also told Li Wei that he needs to learn more from you at work. You are much better than Li Wei in this regard, and he will never be able to surround the leaders of his unit.
Mom, let me help you. Xia Zhenyu changed clothes and prepared to attack Song Juan.
No, no, it’s so hard to rest for a day. How can I use you? You go back to the house and rest. I’ll call you when Li Wei comes back. Song Juan was just happy that Xia Zhenyu allowed her to show her face in front of her old colleagues and classmates, so now she liked Xia Zhenyu no matter how she looked at him.
When Li Wei came back, Song Juan asked Xia Zhenyu to get up and let her and Li Wei have dinner, but she said she would go back to cook for Li Wei's father and left. Xia Zhenyu and Li Wei watched TV for a while after dinner and then went to bed to rest. They chatted as usual, and then Li Wei fell asleep while chatting. Xia Zhenyu felt that she and Li Wei could only maintain a relationship through constant verbal communication, and she must cooperate with Li Wei to break this deadlock.
On this day, as soon as Xia Zhenyu arrived at the unit in the morning, he was called upstairs by Director Zhu. Director Zhu gave Xia Zhenyu a task: Xiaoxia, you are ready. At 9:30, you accompany Director Guo to the city to report on work. How about it? During this period of time, you have almost understood the work content. You can't make mistakes later.
Xia Zhenyu smiled and said: DirectorI follow up on the project every day. Even if I don’t understand something, the technical staff of the center patiently answered it for me.
That's fine, that's fine. When you go to the city to report, you mainly need to prepare Director Guo's materials, and just fill in the gaps when the leader asks questions. Oh, by the way, the leader listening to the report today is Director Zhang. Go ahead and wait for Director Guo's car at the door in a while.
After sorting out the materials, Xia Zhenyu went to the door to wait for Director Guo's car. These materials were all prepared by Xia Zhenyu in order to deal with emergencies anytime and anywhere.
After getting in the car, Director Guo told her a few more words, asking her not to be nervous. She didn't need to speak, but she would just help him fill in the missing data at critical times.
After entering the small conference room of the city government and sitting down, Director Zhang brought people in after a while. Xia Zhenyu glanced at Director Zhang, who was the one who helped everyone out on the day of the inspection.
Director Guo is indeed from a professional background. Although he has become a bit hedonistic after being an official for so many years, his ability is still there. He has learned the lessons from last time and worked hard on his work, so his report is in an orderly manner, and the work progress and opinions and suggestions are reasonable and reasonable.
Just as he was talking, the door of the conference room opened. Director Zhang stood up quickly when he saw the people coming in, and everyone else followed suit. Before Xia Zhenyu understood what was going on, Zhou Jinyu was already sitting on the main seat and motioned to Director Guo to continue. Everyone sat down quietly again.
Xia Zhenyu's face turned red. Just now everyone was sitting together, but she didn't realize it and kept sitting dumbly. Not to mention how conspicuous she was, she saw the people next to her glance at her several times. Why was she so invisible to the big scene? After a while, seeing that no one was paying attention to her, she regained her composure and listened carefully to Director Guo's report and recorded the meeting conversations from time to time.
Zhou Jinyu saw Xia Zhenyu sitting in a daze from the moment he entered the door. It was not until the meeting continued that she realized it and blushed. He had already recognized this girl as the one who greeted his leader last time. This Guo Huai is really bold in hiring people! Seeing her change from blushing to trying to stay calm now, he wanted to laugh, and his eyes felt warm unconsciously.
While listening to the report, Zhou Jinyu secretly looked at Xia Zhenyu and found that the girl was actually quite good-looking. Her skin was very white when she wasn't blushing, not pale but white. It made people want to touch her white porcelain face. She took notes very seriously and was attentive. Zhou Jinyu rarely saw people who blushed so easily. She made a fool of herself twice in formal occasions. She was really a weirdo in the agency!
The meeting was approaching noon during the intense discussion. Zhou Jinyu raised his hand and interrupted the meeting and said: "Everyone has worked very hard today. From the morning until now, we have not eaten lunch in the cafeteria. I asked the secretary to book a hotel first and I will treat everyone to dinner, and then come back to discuss."
Everyone was very happy. What an honor it was to have dinner at the same table with Mayor Zhou. It would be great if we could take photos at the dinner table. Xia Zhenyu packed up her things and went to chase Director Guo. Who knew that he and Director Zhang were still discussing the content of the meeting, and they all got into Director Guo's car, so which car should she get in? Seeing that no one was paying attention to me, I thought that if the cars were all gone later, I could just find a restaurant outside to settle the matter, and then wait for Director Guo to come back.
At this time, a car drove up and stopped in front of her. She was wondering if the attendant remembered to ask her for a ride, but the car door was blocked.
Xia Zhenyu's immediate thought was to refuse. A leader like Zhou Jinyu just wanted to say it. There was no way he would really let her get in the car, but he also thought that the other party could even open the car door.
Countless thoughts flashed through his mind, and finally he said: Thank you, Mayor Zhou, how about I sit in front. After saying that, they sat down in a row.
As a result, the third time he made a fool of himself happened immediately. Xia Zhenyu thought that he had been living in vain all these years. How could such a big leader like Zhou JinyuIs there any secretary or assistant? She was ready to step up, but she saw the person sitting in the passenger seat smiled apologetically at her: Sorry, I am Mayor Zhou's secretary, please sit in the back.
Xia Zhenyu sat in the back seat again with a red face, her courage to look up was gone. The smile on Zhou Jinyu's face became more obvious. He looked at Xia Zhenyu who was still embarrassed and said: Are you the comrade who operated the computer demonstration that time? What's your name?
Hoping that there was a topic that could alleviate his situation, Xia Zhenyu finally raised his head, stared straight ahead, and answered in a low voice: My name is Xia Zhenyu.
Zhou Jinyu understood that most people would be nervous when seeing him, let alone sitting side by side with him in a closed car. His voice became softer: Well, it's a very special name. How long have you worked in the office?
Xia Zhenyu liked that Zhou Jinyu could ask her some questions, so that she would not be embarrassed if she had questions and answers, so she answered all questions: I have been working in the company for almost seven years.
Zhou Jinyu was surprised when he heard this. Seven years? How old is Xia Zhenyu? I always thought she was a college student who just left school. Then I turned around and took a closer look. It is true that Xia Zhenyu can withstand the test at close range. Her face is still as delicate as white porcelain, with a straight nose, red lips, and bright eyes staring at the back of the chair in front of her. She is very young.
It seemed that I had made a mistake, so I smiled and continued: Miss Xia looks really young. Where does her family live, and is her work far from her workplace?
Xia Zhenyu said: Thank you, Mayor Zhou, for your compliment. My home is quite far from my work, and it takes 14 stops to get to work by bus. Mayor Zhou just calls me Xiaoxia.
The author has something to say: the title and main content are the most nerve-wracking.
Also, the cover of Guangguang's book was randomly linked to the top tank from the Internet, so there is no name of the work, please forgive me.
I originally planned to go to bed early, but I didn’t expect
☆, first signs of emergence
Hearing that Xia Zhenyu wanted to call her Xiaoxia, Zhou Jinyu did not respond. Instead, he talked to her about some work matters. He found that Xia Zhenyu knew a lot about this project and had certain insights, so he became interested.
Can you give me your mobile phone number? Zhou Jinyu suddenly asked.
Xia Zhenyu blinked, Zhou Jinyu wanted his mobile phone number? She was a little confused, but she didn't think much about it because it was impossible.
Zhou Jinyu's melodious laughter rang in her ears: Don't get me wrong, I just think you know this digital system very well and must have put a lot of effort into it, so I can communicate with you if I have any questions.
What's the misunderstanding? I haven't been so sentimental yet, so I smiled generously: No, I just didn't expect Mayor Zhou to be so close to the people, and the salary increase for us contract employees this time is also thanks to Mayor Zhou, and I am really grateful.
